description: Critical AI literacy is a developing research direction that extends my work on multilingual and decolonial pedagogies. It draws on the same questions I bring to language-in-education policy: who determines what counts as knowledge, in whose language, and through whose tools. The four activities below represent the documented scope of this work to date.
